# Responsive Dark UI Checklist: PageSpy React Client Mobile-First Dark Refactor

**Purpose**: Requirements quality validation for mobile responsiveness, dark mode, bundle hygiene, and bug remediation
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are mobile viewport constraints (< 768px) and touch target thresholds explicitly specified for all interactive controls? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are touch gesture event handlers (`touchstart`, `touchmove`, `touchend`) documented for all resizable dividers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the specific box-drawing unicode characters and regex cleaning patterns documented for console group extraction? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all 10 identified defects (BUG-01 to BUG-10) mapped to specific functional requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 to §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "phone controls 44px" quantified with exact pixel sizing (`h-11`, `min-h-[44px]`) in component contracts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the dark theme surface specification unambiguous about prohibiting hardcoded `#fff` across legacy panels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the bundle trimming targets specified by exact package names (`cmdk`, `shadcn`, `@fontsource-variable/geist`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do the mobile stacking requirements in User Story 1 align with the technical layout rules in the implementation plan? [Consistency, Spec §US1, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the coexistence of `react-virtualized` and `react-window` consistently defined without conflicting migration directives? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §Principle III]
- [ ] CHK010 Are Tailwind preflight suppression requirements consistent between the constitution, spec, and plan? [Consistency, Constitution §Principle VI, Spec §FR-011]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are requirements defined for multi-finger touch and touch cancellation on the BrowserFrame divider? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for mobile viewport orientation change between portrait and landscape? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements specified for handling non-border box characters occurring inside genuine user log payloads? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
